text: Since your MRI is normal and your hearing is intact, this brief episode strongly suggests benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV). Have you noticed that the spinning sensation specifically happens when you roll over in bed, look up, or tilt your head? speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The clinical presentation of brief, spontaneous vertigo without hearing loss, neurological deficits, or abnormal imaging is classic for BPPV. I recommend starting with the Dix-Hallpike maneuver to confirm the diagnosis before prescribing canalith-repositioning maneuvers.
